description: This file defines a PHP class LicenceAcceptanceController within the OrangeHRM project, responsible for handling license acceptance in the installer flow. It extends an abstract controller, initializes a Vue component for the license acceptance screen, and sets the current screen state.

classes.name: LicenceAcceptanceController
classes.description: Controller handling license acceptance step during installation, rendering the license acceptance Vue component and setting the installation state.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the license acceptance view by initializing the Vue component and setting the current installation screen.
